title: Demo Services Group - Update December 5th
highlights_0: Demo Services Group continues strategic initiatives across governance, platform development, and operational excellence. Key progress includes E6 governance document completion, platform releases (Shift Management / Executive Visibility), and Coast 2026 renewal progress. Operational focus remains on environment stability, external access enablement and Q4 audit completion.
highlights_2: [[bold]]Coast 2026 Renewal  [[/bold]]  – Critical Path Owners :Robert Rossetti, Mario Batiz | Status: Justifying renewal for >$400K BU spending. Platform team and previous budget owners impacted by latest RIF. Working to establish new sponsorship and governance framework.

[[bold]]E6 / International Issuing Hub Governance [[/bold]] Status : Completed | Governance document finalized and in legal review with Christian Battelley. Establishes shared-asset controls, edit pathways, and reporting obligations.

[[bold]]Shift Management Platform [[/bold]] Status : Release Phase | Shift management and audit platform launched due to Shift Governance issue with India Ops. Provides enhanced visibility and control over Demo Operations shift scheduling.

[[bold]]Executive Summary Platform [[/bold]] Status : Release Phase | Centralized reporting platform, increasing executive and leadership visibility on Demo Services initiatives, processes, and data. Standardizes weekly and monthly reporting.

risks_blockers.title: Coast MSA Ownership Gap
risks_blockers.description: Platform team and previous budget owners caught up in latest RIF. Renewal essential for maintaining service continuity for BUs spending >$400K on Coast workspaces.
risks_blockers.mitigation: Demo Services is working with Robert Rossetti and Mario Batiz to provide renewal justification. Working to identify new budget sponsors and establish financial governance framework.

risks_blockers.title: Figma Licenses for Tiled Deployment at Scale
risks_blockers.description: Scaling Tiled/Figma deployment requires additional licenses. Cost modelling needed to support 2025-2026 expansion plans and SKO Launch.
